Tom / team — drafting the runbook here and flagging a couple of operational considerations. Full markdown runbook attached as "evidence-access-runbook.md". Key points:

1) Access window and method
- We can provision temporary, timeboxed view-only links to a secure reviewer bucket for file downloads. Links expire after 72 hours.
- For live configuration screenshots or console access, we prefer scheduled Zoom walkthroughs with the owner present; we do not grant interactive console sessions.

2) Credentials and approvals
- To request runbook access, Orchid should email security@redwoodinference.com with auditor name, company, and requested window.
- Redwood will issue a signed NDA addendum and a short access agreement.

3) Sensitive data handling
- We redact PII and any customer-identifying fields from logs. Where redaction impacts traceability, we provide a redaction manifest and a redaction justification note.

4) Owners & contact list
- Ben Carter — evidence index, IAM and access logs- Marcus Lin — runtime and deployment artifacts- Rachel Kim — compliance owner (escalation)

5) Delivery cadence
- Step 1: Provide selection matrix (Ben) — attached.
- Step 2: Red Team / SecOps do final export and redaction (24 hours) — Marcus to confirm window.
- Step 3: Package + runbook to Orchid (Rachel) — targeted Wed EOD.

Attachment: evidence-access-runbook.md (markdown, 4 pages)

Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
